title: Varken [Classic]
description: What's playing on Plex, what's in the libraries, and what Sonarr, Radarr, SickChill and Ombi are waiting on? The original Varken dashboard, on Varken's Prometheus metrics. The original dashboard's look.

panels.description: Total Streams: Streams playing, paused or buffering now.
Transcode Streams: Streams Plex is transcoding.
Direct Play Streams: Streams playing the file as it is.
Direct Stream: Streams Plex remuxes without transcoding.
Total BW: Bandwidth of the current streams.
LAN BW: Bandwidth of the streams to the local network.
WAN BW: Bandwidth of the streams leaving the local network.
Movies: Movies in the movie libraries.
TV Shows: Shows in the TV libraries.
TV Seasons: Seasons in the TV libraries.
TV Episodes: Episodes in the TV libraries.
4K Movies: Movies in the 4K movie libraries.
4K TV Shows: Shows in the 4K TV libraries.
4K TV Seasons: Seasons in the 4K TV libraries.
4K TV Episodes: Episodes in the 4K TV libraries.
Recently Added Movies: How many more movies the movie libraries hold than at their lowest in the dashboard's time range.
Recently Added TV: How many more episodes the TV libraries hold than at their lowest in the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Device Types
panels.description: Viewing by the player's platform over the dashboard's time range (average concurrent sessions).

panels.title: Stream Types
panels.description: Viewing by video decision (direct play, copy, transcode) over the dashboard's time range (average concurrent sessions).

panels.title: Movies in Queue
panels.description: Movies in Radarr's download queue.

panels.title: Viewer Locations
panels.description: Where the current viewers are, from the GeoLite2 city of each viewer's address. Viewers who can't be placed are left out. Needs `stream_details = true` in Varken.

panels.title: TV Shows in Queue
panels.description: Episodes in Sonarr's download queue.

panels.title: Server Popularity
panels.description: Streams over time.

panels.title: TV Shows on Today (Sonarr)
panels.description: Episodes airing from today through Sonarr's `future_days` (1 by default: today and tomorrow).

panels.title: Users Online
panels.description: Who is watching what, how, and from where. Needs `stream_details = true` in Varken.

panels.title: Missing Available Movies
panels.description: Monitored movies Radarr has no file for, though they are out.

panels.title: Missing TV Shows (Last 7 Days)
panels.description: Monitored episodes without a file that aired in Sonarr's last `missing_days` (7 by default).
Req. Pending: Seerr requests waiting for approval.
Requests Processing: Seerr requests approved and not in the library yet.
Requests Completed: Seerr requests now in the library.
Requests Declined: Seerr requests declined.
Issues Open: Seerr issues still open.
Issues Closed: Seerr issues resolved.

panels.title: Requests Waiting (Seerr)
panels.description: Seerr requests pending approval, or approved and not in the library yet (the 100 newest). The requester is shown only with `stream_details = true` in Varken.

panels.title: Music in Queue
panels.description: Releases in Lidarr's download queue.

panels.title: Missing Albums
panels.description: Monitored albums released in Lidarr's last `missing_days` without every track.

panels.title: Albums Coming Out
panels.description: Albums coming out from today through Lidarr's `future_days`.
